# Blood for iPad and iPhone (NotBlood Chosen 1.2)

Play **Blood** (Monolith, 1997) on **iPad and iPhone**. This is the iOS build of NotBlood Chosen, based on the [NotBlood](https://github.com/clipmove/NotBlood) source port (Build engine). It has touch controls, controller and keyboard/mouse support, bots, and multiplayer with PC, Mac and Android players.

**[Download the IPA (latest release)](https://github.com/AdrianPol-projects/NotBlood-iOS/releases/latest)**: unsigned, for sideloading with Signulous, Sideloadly, AltStore/SideStore or your own developer account. No jailbreak needed. iPadOS/iOS 15 or newer.

The game files are not included. Copy your own Blood files (*One Unit Whole Blood* from GOG or Steam, *Fresh Supply* or the CD) to **Files → On My iPad → NotBlood**.

## Features

- **Touch controls:**
  - floating move stick, drag to look, and action buttons
  - weapon picker and gyro aiming
  - layout editor (move, resize and hide every button)
  - render scale from 100% down to 25%
- **Magic Keyboard, trackpad and mouse** with PC-style mouse look, and **Xbox, PlayStation and MFi controllers**.
- **Renderers:** OpenGL (Polymost, via gl4es) or the classic 8-bit software renderer.
- **Bots** that play like people:
  - 4 difficulties, 6 personalities, and fine tuning for all bots or each one
  - offline matches, a career and a watch-only mode
  - bots in LAN and online games too
- **Match types and mutators:**
  - Bloodbath: gun game, king of the hill, juggernaut, last man standing.
  - Teams: team bloodbath, capture the flag, king of the hill, last team standing.
  - Co-op: survival waves.
  - Mutators: gravity, vampire, one-hit kills, weapon sets.
- **Multiplayer across platforms:** the iPad plays together with Windows, Linux, macOS and Android:
  - LAN game finder
  - online lobbies without port forwarding
  - co-op saves
- **MODS menu** for add-on episodes (Cryptic Passage) and mods. Cutscenes and CD music are supported.
